==Enemies==
'''Reaper''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Reaper]], a summoner enemy that first appears on Wave 36 in [[Pizza Party]].
**[[Reaper/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Void Reaper]], a summoner enemy that first appears on Wave 22 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and on Wave 23 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode.

It can also refer to these removed enemies:
*[[Fallen Reaper]], a summoner enemy that first appeared on Wave 21 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode.

It can also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Reaper (Hexscape)]], a summoner enemy that first appeared on Wave 27 on Easy and Hard difficulty in [[Containment]].
**[[Reaper (Hexscape)/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Reaper (Lunar Overture)]], a summoner enemy that first appeared on Wave 18 in [[The Haunted Past]].
**[[Reaper (Lunar Overture)/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Reaper (Nightmare Carnival)]], a summoner enemy that first appeared on Wave 12 in [[Nightmare Carnival]].
*[[Reaper (Trick or Threat Town)]], a summoner enemy that first appeared on Wave 14 in [[Trick or Threat Town]].
